title: Patch: the rules constants nothing reads are read where their rules are played, and a check keeps it so
thread:
**Issue #1640 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #1640: Patch: the rules constants nothing reads are read where their rules are played, and a check keeps it so
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means
The rules file keeps a setting for each design call the spec left marked "decide", so the designer can flip one and the game follows. Six of those settings are read by nothing; the code writes the same value out by hand. Today, flipping Genn's Greed from odd to even, or allowing two draw offers a turn, silently changes nothing. Once this is built, each setting is either read by the code that plays its rule, or stops the build when set to a value the code can't play. A repository check then fails whenever a new rules setting has no reader. The maintainer and the designer notice; players don't.

## Why
- BUILD.md §2 (`BUILD.md:115`): "Every number below is a named constant … Nothing in the engine hard-codes them."
- Of the `pub const`s in `crates/engine/src/config.rs`, exactly six are named nowhere outside that file except tests and comments: `CRY_ON_PLAY_ONLY` (`:122`, R1), `ROTATION_RING` (`:124`, R14), `GENN_GREED_EXILES` (`:126`, R26), `FIENDER_STATS_MODE` (`:128`, R39), `DRAW_OFFERS_PER_TURN` (`:134`, R36) and `MULLIGAN_ORDER` (`:275`, R9). The scan covered `crates/*/src`, `crates/cards/build.rs` and the config exports. Every other constant is read by a source file, by `build.rs` (`CODE_BLOCK_MAX_LINES`), by another constant in `config.rs`, or by the generated `engineConfig.ts`.
- The code writes these values itself:
  - `crates/cards/src/scripts/core/c094_genns_greed.rs:54` passes `"parity": "odd"`, though `CostFilter.parity` takes "even" too (`crates/engine/src/effects/move_.rs:238-290`).
  - `can_offer_draw` (`crates/engine/src/turn.rs:990-1000`) allows one offer a turn by `offer.offered_turn == Some(state.turn)`, while SPEC §2.5 says of the draw-offer numbers: "both numbers are config values".
- The tests compare the constants with themselves. `crates/engine/tests/rules/rulings_a.rs:1667` (`let wanted = if GENN_GREED_EXILES == "odd" { 1 } else { 0 };`) would break when the constant flips, while the game would not change.
- BUILD.md:143's `RANDOM_KEYWORD_POOL` row still lists Armor 1 and Charge. The pool (`config.rs:230-245`) no longer holds either (R1025000, #1615).

## Proposal
- `c094_genns_greed.rs` reads `GENN_GREED_EXILES` for its parity.
- `can_offer_draw` names `DRAW_OFFERS_PER_TURN`, with a compile-time assertion beside it that it is 1, since more than one offer a turn needs a counter the state does not hold.
- The code that plays R1, R14, R39 and R9 gets a compile-time assertion that its constant holds the one value it implements (`const _: () = assert!(…)`, with a small `const fn` for the string ones), naming the ruling. A designer who flips one then gets a build error at the code to change.
- The self-comparing test asserts become behaviour tests named after their rulings, which they mostly already are.
- `crates/tools/tests/acceptance.rs` gets a check: every `pub const` in the engine's `config.rs` is named, outside comments, by a source file under `crates/*/src`, a `build.rs`, the engine's `tests/export_config.rs`, or another constant in `config.rs`. The check fails today on exactly these six, and an injected unread constant shows it catches one.
- The BUILD.md table is corrected.

## Where it lands
- `crates/engine/src/config.rs`, `crates/engine/src/turn.rs`, the files that play R1, R14, R39 and R9
- `crates/cards/src/scripts/core/c094_genns_greed.rs`
- `crates/engine/tests/rules/{config,rulings_config,rulings_a,rulings_b,triggers,combat_validation}.rs`, where they compare a constant with itself
- `crates/tools/tests/acceptance.rs`
- `BUILD.md` §2

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The new acceptance check fails on the tree before the change, naming the six constants, and passes after it. A unit test of its scanner shows an unread constant is caught and one read only in a comment is not counted.
- [ ] Setting `GENN_GREED_EXILES` to "even" makes R26's behaviour test exile even-cost cards; the pull request shows this was checked and reverted.
- [ ] The R1, R9, R14, R26, R36 and R39 tests still pass, and `cargo jackioh spec check` passes, with every `proven_in` file keeping its named test.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --test rules`, `cargo test -p jackioh-cards c094`, `cargo test -p jackioh-tools --test acceptance`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` and the golden replay pass.

## Size and risks
About 10 files with small edits and no behaviour change at today's values: medium. The scanner must not count comments or `config.rs`'s own definition line, or it passes vacuously. Keep it a token scan with its own test, like the other scans in `acceptance.rs`.
```
